labels.name: Epiphysis
labels.function: Bone end; site of the secondary ossification center

labels.name: Metaphysis
labels.function: Flared transition zone between the shaft and the bone end

labels.name: Diaphysis
labels.function: Main shaft; site of the primary ossification center

labels.name: Articular cartilage
labels.function: Avascular hyaline joint surface; heals poorly

labels.name: Epiphyseal plate
labels.function: Cartilage that lengthens the bone until late adolescence

labels.name: Spongy bone
labels.function: Porous inner network: 20% of bone mass, far more surface area

labels.name: Compact bone
labels.function: Dense outer bone holding about 80% of bone mass

labels.name: Medullary cavity
labels.function: Hollow shaft space filled with fatty yellow marrow

labels.name: Periosteum
labels.function: Dense membrane covering the outer bone surface

labels.name: Endosteum
labels.function: Thin vascular layer lining the inner bone surface

labels.name: Osteon
labels.function: Functional unit of cortical bone, built like tree rings

labels.name: Haversian canal
labels.function: Central channel holding one or two capillaries

labels.name: Volkmann canal
labels.function: Perforating channel carrying vessels in from the surface

labels.name: Lamellae
labels.function: Concentric rings of mineralized matrix

labels.name: Periosteum
labels.function: Dense outer membrane; source of osteoprogenitor cells

labels.name: Osteoblast
labels.function: Lays down type I collagen and osteoid; RANKL signal source

labels.name: Osteocyte
labels.function: Entrapped mechanosensor that coordinates remodeling

labels.name: Canaliculi
labels.function: Tiny channels for cell extensions that pass signals

labels.name: Osteoclast
labels.function: Multinucleated monocyte-lineage cell that resorbs bone

labels.name: Howship lacuna
labels.function: Surface pit carved out during resorption

labels.name: Articular cartilage
labels.function: Hyaline cap at the very end of the bone, facing the joint

labels.name: Secondary ossification center
labels.function: Forms in the epiphysis; the plate separates it from the primary one

labels.name: Zone of reserve
labels.function: Typical resting hyaline cartilage

labels.name: Zone of proliferation
labels.function: Dividing chondrocytes stacked in columns like coins

labels.name: Zone of hypertrophy
labels.function: Swollen, terminally differentiated chondrocytes

labels.name: Zone of calcified cartilage
labels.function: Dying chondrocytes release matrix vesicles; hydroxyapatite forms

labels.name: Zone of ossification
labels.function: Capillaries invade empty lacunae and bone first appears

labels.name: Osteoblast
labels.function: Secretes osteoid onto the calcified spicules
